questions.instructions: Is the item on this receipt line itself alcohol? Yes: The item is alcohol: drinks that contain alcohol: beer, wine, spirits, sake, cocktails, corkage; also wine or spirits sold as a product for cooking. No: It is food_beverage instead: meals, dishes, snacks, desserts, catering and non-alcoholic drinks, including dishes cooked with alcohol and alcohol-free versions of drinks. Decide what the item IS, not what words its name contains. The merchant and the declared expense type are context only and never override the item itself.
